label: sound
instruction_covers: public factory API names and signatures: create_option_by_file, create_option alias, create_option_by_env with JM_OPTION_PATH default, create_option_by_str with mode=None, JmOption.from_file, JmOption.construct with cover_default=True, JmOption.default
default() built from module defaults with cwd base dir, default client impl, retry count, image decode, download cache, and plugin valid mode
by_str YAML parsing with deep merge, .webp suffix decision, and populated unrelated defaults
by_file/alias returning the same option while remembering filepath for to_file() round trips
env loading plus JmcomicException naming the var when unset or empty
construct deep merge without mutating inputs or unrelated default branches
log false disabling normal logging and log pretty enabling pretty logging
batch_count to threading.image migration, plugin to plugins alias, and after_album/after_photo zip level swap
cover_default=False building directly from the complete dictionary
notes: Repo src/jmcomic already provides JmOption (filepath-aware init, decide_image_suffix, deconstruct, to_file), JmModuleConfig.option_default_dict (cwd base dir, cpu_count threading.photo, system proxies), FLAG_ENABLE_JM_LOG/disable_jm_log, PrettyFormatter, jm_logger, AdvancedDict/src_dict, and JmcomicException as ExceptionTool.raises' default type. No hidden test requires behavior outside the instruction plus this existing machinery; the transparency, fresh-process, and no-file-write/network checks only rule out global-state implementations that the stated no-mutation requirement already forbids.
